notes: CANDIDATE 2026-11-13, the dining room's clock after the first picks were rejected (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "those clocks are too dark / hard to read. the first one is terrible and I get a headache trying to make out numbers."). Placement: the dining room's right wall, on the table's center line, 58 in to its center (F-70). Why: a white face with large plain black numerals and black hands, in a walnut-look frame for warmth beside the ash table and white marble (F-68 (10)), at 14 in for the 5 to 16 ft it is read from: the living room's clock is a different design, PresenTime's 16 in Anton square in Antique Hamilton Gold (amazon-B0BBG1TCCL), on Andrew's word (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "I don't want a plain black one though", then "I want 2 diferent clocks for living room / dining"; F-68 (2), F-70). Glass: its reviews are shared with the 18 in, and they report a glass cover that can be removed; take it out before it goes up (F-21). Read 2026-11-13: $32.99, 4.4 stars (108), Q_walnut, 14 Inch, 1.78 lb, plastic frame, white dial. The listing's walnut and natural frames come at 8 to 14 in; natural has pale wood hands, which read less well on white than walnut's black. rooms: the brief.
